title: Dynamics of dN/dS within recombining bacterial populations: analysis code and figure data
description: Analysis code, per-pair data tables and figure-reproduction scripts for Liu & Good, "Dynamics of dN/dS within recombining bacterial populations". The repository vendors the numerical tables underlying every figure (data/), the scripts that regenerate each figure from them (paper_figures/, with a figure-by-figure guide), the NCBI isolate and quasi-phased metagenome preparation pipelines (analysis/), and the forward-time simulation code.
